name: JW Marriott El Convento Cusco
insider_take: Sleep where Spanish conquistadors once prayed - this stunning hotel occupies a 16th-century convent just steps from Machu Picchu's gateway.
whats_special: The JW Marriott El Convento Cusco is built within the walls of the historic Convent of San Agustín, seamlessly blending 500-year-old colonial architecture with luxury amenities. Located at 11,200 feet above sea level, it's one of the world's highest luxury hotels. The property features original stone archways, courtyards, and frescoes alongside oxygen-enriched rooms to help guests adjust to Cusco's altitude.
pro_tip: Arrive 2-3 days before your Machu Picchu visit to acclimatize properly. The hotel's oxygen-enriched rooms and coca tea service will help ease altitude adjustment while you explore Cusco's incredible Inca and colonial heritage.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you within walking distance of Plaza de Armas, Qorikancha (Temple of the Sun), and San Pedro Market. The rooftop bar offers breathtaking views of Cusco's red-tiled roofs and surrounding Andes peaks. Book the hotel's Sacred Valley excursions and exclusive Machu Picchu packages for seamless access to Peru's most iconic archaeological wonder.
pros: Historic 16th-century convent converted into luxury hotel with preserved colonial architecture
Prime location in Cusco's historic center, walking distance to main attractions and Plaza de Armas
Oxygen-enriched rooms to help guests acclimatize to high altitude of 11,200 feet
Award-winning spa and wellness facilities with traditional Andean treatments
cons: High altitude location may require acclimatization period for some guests
Historic building constraints may limit room size and modern amenities in some areas
